acceptance_rule: per crop: eligible for further consideration only if MAE(price+weather) < MAE(persistence) in 2026Q1 AND in 2026Q2, AND the market-clustered 95% CI of skill vs persistence is entirely above 0 in each quarter; identical eligible rows; 10000 replicates, seed 20261022; fixed before any training, never relaxed
disclosures: restricted geography: 46 district points cover about 18-23% of eligible validation rows (coverage CSV)
selection bias: the evaluable markets are reconciled, continuing, weather-district markets only
weather validation is 46 points against IMD gridded analyses, not national validation; Tmax/Tmin location biases up to about 3-4 C are reported, not corrected
excluded: observed future weather used as a forecast
guards: no tuning, no alternative feature sets after results
missing_values: a row is excluded from BOTH methods if any weather feature is NaN (identical rows); no imputation

models.diagnostic: the same estimator on the 9 price features only, trained and scored on the same restricted rows (isolates the weather contribution; not part of the acceptance rule)
models.primary: hgb_conservative unchanged (estimator_params as §7.5) on the 9 registered price features + 5 weather features
models.training: per crop and refit: Phase 8 eligible_by_refit examples ended by the refit, restricted to weather-district series with all weather features non-null

multiple_comparisons: reported, not used to relax: Bonferroni-adjusted (6 crop x quarter tests) 99.17% market-cluster intervals beside the 95% ones; any pass requires confirmation on data after 2026-10-20 before any test-window request
nature: EXPLORATORY. The 2026 validation window already scored the failed price-only learned model (§7.5); this is a second model on the same window, so a pass is an exploratory signal, not confirmation
population: FAQ-only, h = 1, eligible_d41 at the origin, canonical market in one of the 46 weather districts (exact state + district, as Phase 4); every weather feature non-null on the row
question: Does price plus appropriately lagged weather improve on persistence for the same eligible markets and forecast dates?
sensitivity_analyses_reported_not_select: realtime lag: windows ending origin Sunday minus 6 days (about the ERA5 delay)
excluding locations with |Tmax bias| > 2 C or |Tmin bias| > 2 C vs IMD in imd_validation.csv (extension, all seasons)
status: PRE-REGISTERED PROPOSAL; NOT EXECUTED; requires owner authorisation

weather_features.wx_rain_anom_28d: wx_rain_sum_28d minus the climatological mean 28-day sum for the same end day-of-year, fitted only on weather dated <= the applicable refit date (NaN if no earlier year has that window)
weather_features.wx_rain_sum_28d: sum of rain_sum over the 28 days ending L days before the origin Sunday
weather_features.wx_rain_sum_7d: sum of rain_sum over the 7 days ending L days before the origin Sunday
weather_features.wx_tmax_mean_7d: mean of temperature_2m_max over the same 7 days
weather_features.wx_tmin_mean_7d: mean of temperature_2m_min over the same 7 days

weather_source.vintage: Open-Meteo archive as retrieved 2026-10-24 (no API version field exists)
